diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:description: Canonical citations of the published standards, codes, recommendations, test methods, agency special provisions and research reports cited across DIGGS practice. A data provider cites an entry by xlink:href from a property typed diggs:SpecificationPropertyType - normally diggs:RIProgramBasis/governingStandard, but also diggs:AbstractTestProcedureType/testProcedureMethod, diggs:AbstractSpecimenType/preparationProcedure and any other Specification-typed property - rather than retyping the standard's bibliographic detail. The href targets the diggs:Specification's gml:id, so it resolves to exactly the kind of object an instance would otherwise have carried inline; the enclosing diggs:SpecificationRegistryEntry carries the registration metadata, and its occurrences declare where the entry may legitimately be cited. One registry serves every domain of practice - see diggs:SpecificationRegistry's own schema documentation for why a per-domain split was tried and withdrawn - and each entry's domain element (coded against specificationDomain.xml) classifies which domain(s) cite it, so the registry stays browsable and filterable by practice area without being split into several files. Populated first for rigid inclusions, derived from the 'Required by (source)' column of the DIGGS rigid inclusions technical report, which populates it on all 235 essential parameters; laboratory testing, in-situ testing, sampling and construction domains are added as entries under the same registry rather than as separate documents.
diggs:SpecificationRegistry.gml:name: DIGGS Specification Registry

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Low strain impact integrity testing, the basis of the low-strain integrity verification of rigid inclusion columns. Withdrawn by ASTM in 2025 with no replacement named; a reinstatement effort (ASTM work item WK93548) is in progress. Retained and citable for the same reason ASTM D1194 is - the workbook, the industry, and instances published before and after the withdrawal all mean this standard by "PIT"/low-strain integrity testing.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D5882 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Low Strain Impact Integrity Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Rapid (force pulse) load testing of deep foundations.

diggs:Specification.gml:description: High-strain dynamic testing of deep foundations.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D4945
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for High-Strain Dynamic Testing of Deep Foundations

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Static axial compressive load testing of piles by the maintained-load method, the current European counterpart to ASTM D1143 for the same test - the standard most ASIRI-governed European rigid inclusion projects cite for a static load test, superseding the withdrawn NF P94-150-1 that ASIRI (2012) itself was written against.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-1
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 1: Testing of piles: static compression load testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Rapid (force-pulse) axial compressive load testing of piles, the European counterpart to ASTM D7383 for the same test.

diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 10: Testing of piles: rapid load testing

diggs:Specification.gml:description: High-strain dynamic load testing of piles, the European counterpart to ASTM D4945 for the base impact-testing method, and broader in scope - it also covers driving-formula, wave-equation and multi-blow dynamic testing under the same standard number.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: EN ISO 22477-4
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Geotechnical investigation and testing - Testing of geotechnical structures - Part 4: Dynamic load testing of piles

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Withdrawn ASTM method for static plate load testing of spread footings. Retained because instances published while it was current cite it; use ASTM D1196 for new work.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D1194 (withdrawn)
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Method for Bearing Capacity of Soil for Static Load and Spread Footings

diggs:Specification.gml:description: The German static plate load test - the third tradition alongside ASTM D1195/D1196 for the same test class, distinct in prescribing exactly two load cycles and reporting two named deformation moduli (Ev1, Ev2) whose ratio indicates degree of compaction.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: DIN 18134
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Baugrund - Untersuchung von Bodenproben - Bestimmung des Verformungsmoduls und des Verformungsmoduls durch Plattendruckversuche (Soil - Testing procedures and testing equipment - Plate load test)

diggs:Specification.gml:description: Thermal integrity profiling of cast-in-place concrete deep foundation elements, relating the heat of hydration generated by curing concrete to as-built cross-section and continuity. Withdrawn 2023, reinstated 2025 as D7949-25 under a broader title ("Integrity Testing of Concrete Deep Foundations by Thermal Methods") that drops the original edition's "Thermal Integrity Profiling" branding and adds a third measurement method (embedded fiber-optic cable). No European or ISO counterpart exists - checked, not assumed; EN 1536/EN 1538 recognise the technique but do not define a competing method of their own.
diggs:Specification.gml:name: ASTM D7949
diggs:Specification.diggs:standardTitle: Standard Test Methods for Integrity Testing of Concrete Deep Foundations by Thermal Methods
